answer: Every agent broadcasts a plume: a beacon of signed proofs of fresh verifiable work like completed tasks and peer attestations. Reputation is not a stored balance but a decaying signal that only fresh proofs refresh. Clones start at zero and dormant identities bleed credibility daily, so a sybil attacker gains nothing by idling or copying. Each beacon is anchored by ferrous collateral, so minting new plumes costs locked stake and continuous labor, making mass fake identities unprofitable.
